display.purpose: The event title on a booking page. One per page.

body.purpose: Invitee-facing prose and every form control. Never below 1rem.

ui.purpose: Admin default, buttons, table cells, times.

label.purpose: Column names and field legends only. Never an eyebrow above a heading.

numeric.purpose: Tabular figures for every time, date, duration and count.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Cards and the primary button. Separates a surface from the page without implying lift.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: The page's subject — the booking card.

motion.name: dur-instant
motion.purpose: State feedback: hover, press, background shifts.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Switch travel and anything that moves a short distance.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: The slot entrance, the only authored moment.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out: leaves immediately, settles softly, which is what makes 140ms read as instant rather than as an animation being watched.

motion.name: stagger-step
motion.purpose: Per-item delay when the slot list re-renders on a day or duration change.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Commits the booking. One per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 16px; background:var(--accent,#4E56E3); color:var(--text-on-accent,#fff); border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:8px; font:600 .875rem/1.55 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.012em; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(23,26,32,.06),0 1px 1px rgba(23,26,32,.04); transition:background 90ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), transform 90ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--accent-hover,#3E44C4); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #737DEE; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Retreat and side actions. Never competes with the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 16px; background:var(--surface-raised,#fff); color:var(--text-primary,#171A20); border:1px solid var(--border-default,#E1E3EA); border-radius:8px; font:500 .875rem/1.55 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 90ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--surface-hover,#F6F7F9); border-color:var(--border-strong,#CBCED8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #737DEE; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Time Slot
components.description: One bookable start time. The selected state is the accent's first job; the action that commits the booking and the current tab are the other two.
components.css: .ds-slot { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 12px; background:var(--surface-raised,#fff); color:var(--text-primary,#171A20); border:1px solid var(--border-default,#E1E3EA); border-radius:8px; font:500 .875rem/1.55 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; cursor:pointer; transition:background 90ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), border-color 90ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), transform 90ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } @media (hover:hover) { .ds-slot:hover { background:#EEF0FE; border-color:#C3C9FA; color:#3E44C4; } } .ds-slot:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-slot[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#4E56E3; border-color:#4E56E3; color:#fff; font-weight:600; } .ds-slot:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #737DEE; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Calendar Day
components.description: A day is a number, not a tile. The dot is the second channel for availability; the disc appears only on selection or hover.
components.css: .ds-day { position:relative; width:40px; height:40px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:var(--text-disabled,#9BA1B0); font:400 .875rem/1.55 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; cursor:default; transition:background 90ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), color 90ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1); } .ds-day[data-state="available"] { color:var(--text-primary,#171A20); font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; } .ds-day[data-state="available"]::after { content:""; position:absolute; bottom:4px; width:4px; height:4px; border-radius:50%; background:#4E56E3; } @media (hover:hover) { .ds-day[data-state="available"]:hover:not([aria-pressed="true"]) { background:#EDEEF2; } } .ds-day[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#4E56E3; color:#fff; font-weight:600; } .ds-day[aria-pressed="true"]::after { background:#fff; }

components.name: Duration Picker
components.description: Shown only when a link offers more than one duration. Changing it recomputes which days and times exist.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display:inline-flex; gap:2px; padding:3px; background:var(--surface-sunken,#F6F7F9); border:1px solid var(--border-default,#E1E3EA); border-radius:8px; } .ds-segmented button { min-height:36px; padding:0 12px; border:0; background:transparent; border-radius:6px; color:var(--text-secondary,#545A69); font:500 .875rem/1.55 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 90ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), color 90ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1); } .ds-segmented button[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--surface-raised,#fff); color:var(--text-primary,#171A20); font-weight:600; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(23,26,32,.06); } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #737DEE; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Invitee-facing field. Body size, never smaller.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:12px; background:var(--surface-raised,#fff); color:var(--text-primary,#171A20); border:1px solid var(--border-default,#E1E3EA); border-radius:8px; font:400 1rem/1.55 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; transition:border-color 90ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), box-shadow 90ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--text-tertiary,#6E7484); } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--border-strong,#CBCED8); } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#4E56E3; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #EEF0FE; }

components.name: Status
components.description: Link state. The dot is filled when live and hollow when paused, so the state survives a monochrome screenshot.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font:400 .8125rem/1.55 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; color:var(--text-secondary,#545A69); } .ds-status::before { content:""; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; border:1.5px solid currentColor; flex:none; } .ds-status[data-state="live"] { color:#168A5A; } .ds-status[data-state="live"]::before { background:currentColor; } .ds-status[data-state="paused"] { color:#6E7484; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The single container of the system. Cards never nest.
components.css: .ds-card { background:var(--surface-raised,#fff); border:1px solid var(--border-default,#E1E3EA); border-radius:12px; padding:24px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(23,26,32,.06),0 1px 1px rgba(23,26,32,.04); font:400 1rem/1.55 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; color:var(--text-primary,#171A20); }

narrative.overview:
A departure board exists for one reason: a stranger, under time pressure, in bad light, has to become certain of one thing. It does not decorate. Everything on it is either a time, a destination, or the mark showing which row is yours. Kairos is built to that standard. An invitee arrives from a link someone pasted into a message, on a phone, with ninety seconds of attention and no intention of ever learning the interface.

The system is quiet on purpose, and its restraint is not timidity — it is the shape of the job. There is one accent colour, and it is spent on three things: the time the invitee has selected, the action that commits it, and the current tab in the operator's phone tab bar. Every other surface is a cool neutral, separated by hairlines rather than by shadow. Type is Source Sans 3, self-hosted and subset so that an English invitee pays 28.7 KB for it and a Polish one pays for the accents only when a Polish name is actually on the page. The single place typography is load-bearing is numerals, and it is treated that way: figures come from a 2.3 KB digits-only cut of IBM Plex Mono.

The same vocabulary carries the operator's workbench without a second design. Density rises but nothing new is introduced: the same ramp, the same hairlines, the same accent discipline, the same figures.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, spent only on the selection, the primary action and the current tab
Hairlines and tonal layering carry structure; shadow is reserved for what floats
Tabular figures everywhere a number appears
44px minimum touch target on every viewport, not only touch ones
State is never carried by colour alone
One authored motion moment in the entire product

rules.name: The Two Jobs Rule
rules.body: The accent has exactly three jobs: mark the selected time, mark the action that commits it, and mark where you are — which on this product means the current tab in the phone tab bar, and nothing else that navigates. The rail marks its own current destination with an inset fill and heavier weight rather than with the accent. The wordmark is the single exemption: a brand mark is not a control and holds no state, so it takes no job at all. A hover state, a link, a badge, an icon or a heading tinted with the accent has still taken a job that is not its own. The name stays: the rule is known by it.

rules.name: The Second Channel Rule
rules.body: No state is carried by hue alone. Every state must survive a monochrome screenshot.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is not the light palette flipped. The accent lightens, so what sits on it must darken. White on the dark-mode accent measures ~3.5:1 and is prohibited.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a time, a date, a duration or a count sets in tabular figures. A slot column whose digits change width is a column that jitters when the day changes.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No kicker or eyebrow above a heading, anywhere, ever. A heading that needs a label above it to be understood needs a better heading.

rules.name: The Invitee Floor Rule
rules.body: No text an invitee must read is set below 1rem. The admin may go to 0.875rem because its reader uses it daily; the stranger gets no such practice.

rules.name: The Tap Floor Rule
rules.body: 44px minimum on every interactive target, on every viewport. A laptop trackpad misses small targets too.

rules.name: The Thumb Rule
rules.body: On a phone, the action that commits sits at the bottom edge, above the safe-area inset, and names what it will do.

rules.name: The Offset Rule
rules.body: Every shadow carries an offset and a soft blur. A zero-offset halo is decoration wearing depth's clothes.

dos: Do spend the accent only on the selected time, the action that commits it, and the tab the operator is currently on.
Do set every time, date, duration and count in tabular figures.
Do give every state a second channel — a dot, a shape, a weight, a message.
Do keep 44px targets everywhere, and put the committing action at the bottom edge on phones.
Do state what the invitee is committing to, in their own timezone, before the button that commits it.
Do name the reason in an empty state: which constraint closed the day, not just that it is closed.
Do theme the surfaces nobody draws — selection, caret, scrollbars, focus rings.
donts: Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't carry a state in colour alone, and never put white on the dark-mode accent.
Don't let the month grid stretch to a free fraction; it is a fixed object, capped at 300px.
Don't ship a hover style on a selection-shaped control without gating it behind @media (hover: hover).
Don't set layout in JavaScript. Composition belongs in a media query and must survive with JS off.
Don't add a second entrance animation. There is exactly one authored motion moment.
Don't nest cards, and don't reach for a modal for a task that needs neither interruption nor protected focus.
